provenance: Yao et al. 2022 Cell Reports Table S6, human L2/3 PV (Allen ID 529807751) and VIP (525018757) models (n=1 each): cm 2.0 uF/cm2 uniform, Ra 100 ohm cm (fixed from Hay et al. 2011, never fitted in human). Rm_qc = 1/g_pas of the VIP model, 2.58e-5 -> 38760 ohm cm2 (gate only; PV's would be 1/1.18e-4 = 8475; VIP chosen as the larger share of Yao's composition, 8% vs 7% -- either passes the 0.01-200 mV C4 window). CAVEAT [KB, Guet-McCreight et al. 2023 own words]: their PV cm=2 was set 'to reproduce membrane time constants (possibly due to errors in PV dendritic diameter estimation)' -- a fit compensation for those morphologies, not a membrane measurement. Decision D-003 (2026-09-21): both variants are exported
